_doc: A body falling, its joints damped (Prender-264, Ragdoll::damp_joints, Mueller et al. 2007 3.5): a round at the head of the walker nearest the street corner at (60, 8) ({roundAt}: LookArgs; no fire, so nothing hides the limbs), the camera on the corner before so the walker is drawn and falls from its own pose; two frames after it the camera on the body (setViewNear body, 110 px a metre, from 210 degrees at 35: from 30 a street tree stood between), then held there while the clock runs: shots 4, 10, 20 and 45 frames on, the limbs swinging less and less as the body goes down whole; and at rest from above. A first take aimed at a blow's body inside its fire, where flames hid the limbs.
